name: contenteditable-sandbox
description: Basic sandbox for playing around with contentEditable and discovering its crazy behaviour.
author: Ed Sanders

scripts.update-lib: npm install --no-save jquery@4.0.0 js-beautify@2.0.3 && mkdir -p lib && cp node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.min.map lib/ && grep -v sourceMappingURL node_modules/js-beautify/js/lib/beautifier.min.js > lib/beautifier.min.js
